title: Your brain marked that cringe IMPORTANT 😬 #shorts
description:
You said "you too" to a waiter. Four years later your brain still has it. 😬 When a moment stirs up shame or embarrassment, the amygdala helps tag it as important — so your brain didn't keep that memory by accident. It kept it on purpose.

Watch the full video: https://youtu.be/fN20EY-EMLk

#psychology #cringe #shorts
